must: Ship as one self-contained index.html plus files in site/assets, no build step
Use the brand palette only: navy #2C2D48, sky #18C3F3 (agency), gold #BB7F27 (academy), white #FEFEFE
Swap the whole arm via body[data-arm], never by duplicating styles
Asset paths must be root-absolute (/assets/...), relative paths 404 on nested SPA routes
Netlify SPA fallback must be status 200, not 301, or deep links break
Keep every page in the DOM, not in <template>, so Netlify Forms can detect the forms
Space Grotesk for display, Inter for body, JetBrains Mono for micro-labels
Gate all motion behind prefers-reduced-motion, and pointer effects behind (pointer: fine)
Use real, verifiable facts only, never invented statistics, testimonials or colleague bios
avoid: Marketing jargon: leverage, synergy, unlock, elevate, seamless, cutting-edge, in today's fast-paced world
Frameworks or bundlers, this site stays dependency free
Fabricated client logos, quotes, numbers or team bios
Personal-brand content, this is a company site and the books belong on the personal site
More than one primary call to action per section
